sections.text:
3.8 PP/DS Optimizer Settings
This can be useful if you want to suppress specific information messages from the
application log, but you want other information message logs to be generated by the
system. In the ExM Prio column 5, you can set a priority for the application log mes-
sage. Value 1 holds the highest priority, and value 99 holds the lowest priority. In the
functionality to display the log for the last planning run, which can be accessed by
using Transaction /SAPAPO/POV1 and selecting the Planning Run Info., as shown in
Figure 3.55, the message with the highest priority set in the exception group will be dis-
played in the Exception Message column.
If the value Create a Database Alert is set in the DB Alert column (refer to Figure 3.54 6), the
system will also generate an alert for the Alert Monitor and will save this alert message in
database table /SAPAPO/ALERT_HP. We’ll cover the details regarding alerts in Chapter 7.
Figure 3.55 Display of the Highest Priority Exception Message in the Planning Run Info
Warning
Don’t set the DB Alert option in the exception messages in the exception group unless
you have specific requirements. This may lead to performance bottlenecks in the PP/DS
planning runs.
3.8 PP/DS Optimizer Settings
In this section, we’ll cover the technical setup of the PP/DS optimizer. The setup of opti-
mizer profiles and other application settings that are used to optimize the production
plan and the production schedule will be covered in Chapter 5 and Chapter 6 during our
discussion of production planning topics and detailed scheduling topics, respectively.
In embedded PP/DS in SAP S/4HANA 2022, there are two optimizer engines available in
the standard system:
 Production Planning Optimizer
The Production Planning Optimizer is a functionality that was introduced in SAP
S/4HANA 2020 and continues to evolve with new features and functionalities. The
Production Planning Optimizer (also called the Production Planning Solver) is a
cost-based optimization engine used to create an optimal production plan. The opti-
mizer considers costs such as manufacturing/capacity, procurement, transporta-
tion, storage costs and penalties for late fulfillments, and violations of safety stock
requirements.

3 Configuration
170
 Detailed Scheduling Optimizer
The Detailed Scheduling Optimizer has existed from the initial release of embedded
PP/DS, and it’s also available in the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization solu-
tion as well. The Detailed Scheduling Optimizer is also a cost-based optimization
engine, which will optimize the production schedule and optimal resource utiliza-
tion of manufacturing resources. It considers various costs such as setup/change-
over costs, delay costs, and mode costs (i.e., costs incurred by specific resources) to
execute the production.
In addition, you can combine the production planning and detailed scheduling optimi-
zation in a single run to arrive at an optimal plan, which the Production Planning Opti-
mizer calculates and that will be further optimized by the Detailed Scheduling
Optimizer for an optimal production schedule.
When an optimizer run is executed, the master data and relevant transaction data is
read from the SAP S/4HANA database tables and SAP liveCache. Along with this data,
the constraints defined in the optimizer profile are sent to the optimizer server. Then,
the optimizer server will execute the optimization program based on the data and the
parameters supplied. The output of the Production Planning Optimizer will be new
procurement elements, and the output of the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer will be
changed dates and times. The optimizer server will call the SAP S/4HANA system to cre-
ate the procurement elements and the updates to the existing orders in SAP liveCache.

3.8 PP/DS Optimizer Settings
The optimizer is an optional component of embedded PP/DS. The Production Planning
Optimizer and the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer are installed on a separate server
with standalone SAP Gateway installed. Another option is to install the optimizer in the
same server as the SAP application server for the SAP S/4HANA system. The usual
deployment method is to have a standalone server for the PP/DS optimizer that is sized
according to the workload expected to be handled by the Production Planning and
Detailed Scheduling Optimizers and not sharing the load with any other applications.
In the PP/DS optimizer server, it’s possible to install more than one optimizer software
instance because the same PP/DS optimizer server can be used by multiple systems,
including the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system. The same PP/DS opti-
mizer server may contain the software executables for supply network planning, capable-
to-match (CTM), and so on. The Production Planning Optimizer and Detailed Schedul-
ing Optimizer installed executables can be used by embedded PP/DS.
After the Production Planning Optimizer and Detailed Scheduling Optimizer execut-
ables and the required SAP Gateway components are installed in the standalone server,
an RFC destination of type TCP/IP is created in the SAP S/4HANA system. For the Produc-
tion Planning Optimizer, the path of the corresponding optimizer executable for the Pro-
duction Planning Optimizer is maintained in the technical settings of the RFC
destination, as shown in Figure 3.57. Embedded PP/DS technically uses the SAP Advanced
Planning and Optimization supply network planning (SNP) optimizer engine. So, in the
Program path, you’ll notice that program is pointing to the SNP optimizer executable in
the optimizer server.

After the RFC destination is set up, the configuration of the PP/DS optimizer is main-
tained under the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Basic
Settings  Optimization Basic Functions  Maintain Master Data for Optimization Server.
In this Customizing transaction, click the New Entries button. Set the Dest. ID as
“DPS01” and the Appl. as “DPS”, as shown in Figure 3.59 1 for the Detailed Scheduling
Optimizer. If there are multiple PP/DS optimizer servers available, and you want to pri-
oritize one of the servers, enter a number in the P (priority) field that is lower than the
other entries. The entry with the lowest number in the P field gets the first preference
when the embedded PP/DS application requests the connection to an PP/DS optimizer
server. Similarly, for the Production Planning Optimizer, make an entry with Dest. ID as
“PPO01” and the Appl. as “PPO” 2.
Figure 3.59 PP/DS Optimizer Technical Settings
The maximum number of slots (M) determines how many CPU processing cores the
PP/DS application can request at once when running an optimization operation. In Fig-
ure 3.59, the maximum number of slots is defined as “10”. Next, enter the RFC destina-
tion that is created for the Production Planning Optimizer 3 and Detailed Scheduling
Optimizer 4, respectively, in the Communication Connection field. When you’re done,
click the Save button to save the Production Planning Optimizer and Detailed Schedul-
ing Optimizer settings.
3.9 Summary
In this chapter, we covered in detail the activation and setup of embedded PP/DS,
including the technical setup of the PP/DS optimizer. Embedded PP/DS requires

explicit activation and the SAP liveCache installed and set up on the SAP HANA data-
base that the SAP S/4HANA system is connected to.
For most of the transaction data, transfers between the ERP and PP/DS side of SAP
S/4HANA don’t require an integration model. However, it internally uses the core
interface framework to transfer the data, so the basic setup of the core interface is
required in the SAP S/4HANA system. For PP/DS master data elements, the Customiz-
ing is maintained under the advanced planning Customizing settings.
We also covered the important settings and profiles required to use the PP/DS applica-
tion tools in embedded PP/DS, such as the order views and the detailed scheduling
planning board.
In the next chapter, we’ll cover the details of the transaction data in embedded PP/DS
and how that data is transferred between SAP S/4HANA and embedded PP/DS. We’ll
also cover how the transaction data is represented in embedded PP/DS, as well as the
version management in PP/DS for simulating the master data changes and its impact
on transaction data.
